Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 2
Introduction
Northwind Software builds project and payroll software for small businesses. We have offices
in Bengaluru and Chennai and about 420 employees.
Our values
We expect everyone to be honest, to respect each other and to take ownership of their work.
These values guide every policy in this handbook.
Probation
New employees have a probation period of 6 months. During probation, the notice period is 15
days for both sides. Your manager meets you after 3 months to review how things are going.
Working days
The working week is Monday to Friday. Saturday and Sunday are weekly holidays, unless your
team works in shifts. Shift teams get two weekly holidays according to their roster.
Where to find help
Your manager is the first person to ask about day-to-day matters. The People team handles
leave, pay and policy questions. The IT helpdesk, at helpdesk@northwind.example, handles
laptops, accounts and access.
